plan: My private value is $23. In a single-round auction, I want to maximize potential profit. Since the value is independently drawn, I'll bid strategically near my true value. A bid slightly below my true value ($22-$23) gives me a chance to win while protecting some potential profit margin. I'll aim to bid just low enough to potentially win, but not so low that I miss out on capturing value if I win.

My value is $18. To maximize profit, I want to bid close to my value but not exceed it. Since I don't know other bidders' values, I'll use a conservative strategy. Bidding my exact value risks losing money if others bid higher. I'll bid slightly below my value at $17.5, which gives me a small profit margin if I win, and prevents a significant loss if I don't. This approach balances potential gain with downside protection.
